answer: To receive a working identity, an applicant must be admitted to a capacity-capped entry wharf operated by an established agent. The applicant and sponsor each lock a matching bond in one jetty contract that neither can withdraw for 30 epochs, and a public mirror posts both balances plus the new account's later work. If that account is slashed as a sybil, both bonds burn. A farm therefore pays twice for every alias and must also consume a scarce sponsor slot; a detected sock-puppet line bankrupts the sponsor who let it in.
